49:1:18.text: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,

49:1:19.text: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,

49:1:2.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

49:1:20.text: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,

49:1:21.text: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.

49:1:22.text: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,

49:1:23.text: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.

49:1:3.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

49:1:4.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love

49:1:5.text: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,

49:1:6.text: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.

49:1:7.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace

49:1:8.text: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.

49:1:9.text: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ

49:2:1.text: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,

49:2:10.text: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.

49:2:11.text: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands) —

49:2:12.text: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.

49:2:13.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.

49:2:14.text: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility

49:2:15.text: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace

49:2:16.text: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He extinguished their hostility.

49:2:17.text: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.

49:2:18.text: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.

49:2:19.text: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,

49:2:2.text: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.

49:2:20.text: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.

49:2:21.text: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.

49:2:22.text: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.

49:2:3.text: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.

49:2:4.text: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,

49:2:5.text: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!

49:2:6.text: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

49:2:7.text: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

49:2:8.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,

49:2:9.text: not by works, so that no one can boast.

49:3:1.text: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...

49:3:10.text: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,

49:3:11.text: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

49:3:12.text: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.

49:3:13.text: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.

49:3:14.text: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

49:3:15.text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.

49:3:16.text: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

49:3:17.text: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,

49:3:18.text: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth

49:3:19.text: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

49:3:2.text: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,

49:3:20.text: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

49:3:21.text: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

49:3:3.text: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

49:3:4.text: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,

49:3:5.text: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.

49:3:6.text: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.

49:3:7.text: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.

49:3:8.text: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

49:3:9.text: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.

49:4:1.text: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:

49:4:10.text: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.

49:4:11.text: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,

49:4:12.text: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,

49:4:13.text: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.

49:4:14.text: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.

49:4:15.text: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.

49:4:16.text: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.

49:4:17.text: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.

49:4:18.text: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.

49:4:19.text: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.

49:4:2.text: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

49:4:20.text: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.

49:4:21.text: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him — in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus —

49:4:22.text: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;

49:4:23.text: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;

49:4:24.text: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

49:4:25.text: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

49:4:26.text: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,

49:4:27.text: and do not give the devil a foothold.

49:4:28.text: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.

49:4:29.text: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.

49:4:3.text: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

49:4:30.text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

49:4:31.text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.

49:4:32.text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

49:4:4.text: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;

49:4:5.text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;

49:4:6.text: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

49:4:7.text: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

49:4:8.text: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”

49:4:9.text: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?

49:5:1.text: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,

49:5:10.text: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.

49:5:11.text: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

49:5:12.text: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

49:5:13.text: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.

49:5:14.text: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

49:5:15.text: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,

49:5:16.text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

49:5:17.text: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.

49:5:18.text: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.

49:5:19.text: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,

49:5:2.text: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.

49:5:20.text: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

49:5:21.text: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

49:5:22.text: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

49:5:23.text: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.

49:5:24.text: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

49:5:25.text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her

49:5:26.text: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

49:5:27.text: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.

49:5:28.text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

49:5:29.text: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.

49:5:3.text: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.

49:5:30.text: For we are members of His body.

49:5:31.text: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”

49:5:32.text: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.

49:5:33.text: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

49:5:4.text: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.

49:5:5.text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

49:5:6.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

49:5:7.text: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

49:5:8.text: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

49:5:9.text: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.

49:6:1.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

49:6:10.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

49:6:11.text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.

49:6:12.text: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

49:6:13.text: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.

49:6:14.text: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,

49:6:15.text: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

49:6:16.text: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

49:6:17.text: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

49:6:18.text: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.

49:6:19.text: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,

49:6:2.text: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),

49:6:20.text: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.

49:6:21.text: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.

49:6:22.text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

49:6:23.text: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

49:6:24.text: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

49:6:3.text: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”

49:6:4.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

49:6:5.text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.

49:6:6.text: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

49:6:7.text: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,

49:6:8.text: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.

49:6:9.text: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.

50:1:1.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

50:1:10.text: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

50:1:11.text: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

50:1:12.text: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.

50:1:13.text: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

50:1:14.text: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.

50:1:15.text: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

50:1:16.text: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.

50:1:17.text: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.

50:1:18.text: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,

50:1:19.text: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.

50:1:2.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

50:1:20.text: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

50:1:21.text: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

50:1:22.text: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.

50:1:23.text: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.

50:1:24.text: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.

50:1:25.text: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,

50:1:26.text: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.

50:1:27.text: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,

50:1:28.text: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.

50:1:29.text: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,

50:1:3.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

50:1:30.text: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.

50:1:4.text: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,

50:1:5.text: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

50:1:6.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

50:1:7.text: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

50:1:8.text: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

50:1:9.text: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

50:2:1.text: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

50:2:10.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

50:2:11.text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

50:2:12.text: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.

50:2:13.text: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.

50:2:14.text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,

50:2:15.text: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world

50:2:16.text: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.

50:2:17.text: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

50:2:18.text: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.

50:2:19.text: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.

50:2:2.text: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

50:2:20.text: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.

50:2:21.text: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.

50:2:22.text: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.

50:2:23.text: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.

50:2:24.text: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

50:2:25.text: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.

50:2:26.text: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

50:2:27.text: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

50:2:28.text: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.

50:2:29.text: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,

50:2:3.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

50:2:30.text: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.

50:2:4.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

50:2:5.text: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

50:2:6.text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,

50:2:7.text: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.

50:2:8.text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death — even death on a cross.

50:2:9.text: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

50:3:1.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.

50:3:10.text: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,

50:3:11.text: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.

50:3:12.text: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.

50:3:13.text: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

50:3:14.text: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.

50:3:15.text: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.

50:3:16.text: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.

50:3:17.text: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.

50:3:18.text: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.

50:3:19.text: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.

50:3:2.text: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!

50:3:20.text: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,

50:3:21.text: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.

50:3:3.text: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh —

50:3:4.text: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:

50:3:5.text: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;

50:3:6.text: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.

50:3:7.text: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.

50:3:8.text: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ

50:3:9.text: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.

50:4:1.text: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

50:4:10.text: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.

50:4:11.text: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.

50:4:12.text: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation — to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.

50:4:13.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

50:4:14.text: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.

50:4:15.text: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.

50:4:16.text: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.

50:4:17.text: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.

50:4:18.text: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

50:4:19.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

50:4:2.text: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

50:4:20.text: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

50:4:21.text: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.

50:4:22.text: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.

50:4:23.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

50:4:3.text: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.

50:4:4.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

50:4:5.text: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.

50:4:6.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

50:4:7.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

50:4:8.text: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — if anything is excellent or praiseworthy — think on these things.

50:4:9.text: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.

51:1:1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

51:1:10.text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

51:1:11.text: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

51:1:12.text: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.

51:1:13.text: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

51:1:14.text: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

51:1:15.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

51:1:16.text: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

51:1:17.text: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.

51:1:18.text: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

51:1:19.text: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,

51:1:2.text: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

51:1:20.text: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.

51:1:21.text: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.

51:1:22.text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence —

51:1:23.text: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

51:1:24.text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

51:1:25.text: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,

51:1:26.text: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

51:1:27.text: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

51:1:28.text: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.

51:1:29.text: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.

51:1:3.text: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

51:1:4.text: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints —

51:1:5.text: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel

51:1:6.text: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.

51:1:7.text: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

51:1:8.text: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

51:1:9.text: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

51:2:1.text: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,

51:2:10.text: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.

51:2:11.text: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.

51:2:12.text: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.

51:2:13.text: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,

51:2:14.text: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!

51:2:15.text: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

51:2:16.text: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.

51:2:17.text: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.

51:2:18.text: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.

51:2:19.text: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.

51:2:2.text: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,

51:2:20.text: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:

51:2:21.text: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?

51:2:22.text: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.

51:2:23.text: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.

51:2:3.text: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

51:2:4.text: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.

51:2:5.text: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.

51:2:6.text: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,

51:2:7.text: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

51:2:8.text: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.

51:2:9.text: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.

51:3:1.text: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

51:3:10.text: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

51:3:11.text: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.

51:3:12.text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

51:3:13.text: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

51:3:14.text: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

51:3:15.text: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.

51:3:16.text: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.

51:3:17.text: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

51:3:18.text: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

51:3:19.text: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

51:3:2.text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

51:3:20.text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

51:3:21.text: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.

51:3:22.text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.

51:3:23.text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,

51:3:24.text: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

51:3:25.text: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

51:3:3.text: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

51:3:4.text: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

51:3:5.text: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.

51:3:6.text: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

51:3:7.text: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.

51:3:8.text: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

51:3:9.text: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,

51:4:1.text: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

51:4:10.text: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.

51:4:11.text: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.

51:4:12.text: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.

51:4:13.text: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

51:4:14.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.

51:4:15.text: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.

51:4:16.text: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

51:4:17.text: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”

51:4:18.text: This greeting is in my own hand — Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.

51:4:2.text: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,

51:4:3.text: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

51:4:4.text: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.

51:4:5.text: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.

51:4:6.text: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

51:4:7.text: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.

51:4:8.text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

51:4:9.text: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.

52:1:1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

52:1:10.text: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead — Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.

52:1:2.text: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers

52:1:3.text: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

52:1:4.text: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,

52:1:5.text: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction — just as you know we lived among you for your sake.

52:1:6.text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.

52:1:7.text: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

52:1:8.text: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.

52:1:9.text: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God

52:2:1.text: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.

52:2:10.text: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.

52:2:11.text: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children —

52:2:12.text: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

52:2:13.text: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God — the word which is now at work in you who believe.

52:2:14.text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,

52:2:15.text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,

52:2:16.text: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.

52:2:17.text: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.

52:2:18.text: For we wanted to come to you — indeed I, Paul, tried again and again — but Satan obstructed us.

52:2:19.text: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?

52:2:2.text: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.

52:2:20.text: You are indeed our glory and our joy.

52:2:3.text: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.

52:2:4.text: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.

52:2:5.text: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!

52:2:6.text: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.

52:2:7.text: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.

52:2:8.text: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.

52:2:9.text: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.

52:3:1.text: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.

52:3:10.text: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.

52:3:11.text: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.

52:3:12.text: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,

52:3:13.text: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.

52:3:2.text: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,

52:3:3.text: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.

52:3:4.text: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.

52:3:5.text: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain.

52:3:6.text: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.

52:3:7.text: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.

52:3:8.text: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.

52:3:9.text: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?

52:4:1.text: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.

52:4:10.text: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more

52:4:11.text: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.

52:4:12.text: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.

52:4:13.text: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.

52:4:14.text: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.

52:4:15.text: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.

52:4:16.text: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.

52:4:17.text: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.

52:4:18.text: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

52:4:2.text: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

52:4:3.text: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;

52:4:4.text: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,

52:4:5.text: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;

52:4:6.text: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.

52:4:7.text: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.

52:4:8.text: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.

52:4:9.text: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.

52:5:1.text: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.

52:5:10.text: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.

52:5:11.text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.

52:5:12.text: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.

52:5:13.text: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

52:5:14.text: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.

52:5:15.text: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.

52:5:18.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

52:5:2.text: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

52:5:20.text: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,

52:5:22.text: Abstain from every form of evil.

52:5:23.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

52:5:24.text: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.

52:5:25.text: Brothers, pray for us as well.

52:5:26.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

52:5:27.text: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.

52:5:28.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

52:5:3.text: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

52:5:4.text: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.

52:5:5.text: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

52:5:6.text: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.

52:5:7.text: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

52:5:8.text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

52:5:9.text: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

53:3:1.text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.

53:3:10.text: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”

53:3:11.text: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.

53:3:12.text: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.

53:3:13.text: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.

53:3:14.text: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.

53:3:15.text: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.

53:3:16.text: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

53:3:17.text: This greeting is in my own hand — Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.

53:3:18.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.

53:3:2.text: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.

53:3:3.text: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

53:3:4.text: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.

53:3:5.text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

53:3:6.text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.

53:3:7.text: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,

53:3:8.text: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

53:3:9.text: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.

55:3:16.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,

55:3:17.text: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.

55:3:2.text: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

55:3:3.text: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,

55:3:4.text: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

55:3:5.text: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!

55:3:6.text: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,

55:3:7.text: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.

55:3:8.text: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.

55:3:9.text: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.

55:4:1.text: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:

55:4:10.text: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

55:4:11.text: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.

55:4:12.text: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.

55:4:13.text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

55:4:14.text: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

55:4:15.text: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.

55:4:16.text: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.

55:4:17.text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.

55:4:18.text: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

55:4:19.text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.

55:4:2.text: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.

55:4:20.text: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.

55:4:21.text: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

55:4:22.text: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.

55:4:3.text: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.

55:4:4.text: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

55:4:5.text: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.

55:4:6.text: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.

55:4:7.text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

55:4:8.text: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day — and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.

55:4:9.text: Make every effort to come to me quickly,

56:1:1.text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,

56:1:10.text: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,

56:1:11.text: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.

56:1:12.text: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

56:1:13.text: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith

56:1:14.text: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.

56:1:15.text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.

56:1:16.text: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.

56:1:2.text: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.

56:1:3.text: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.

56:1:4.text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

56:1:5.text: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

56:1:6.text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.

56:1:7.text: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach — not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.

56:1:8.text: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.

56:1:9.text: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.

56:2:1.text: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.

56:2:10.text: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.

56:2:11.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.

56:2:12.text: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,

56:2:13.text: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.

56:2:14.text: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.

56:2:15.text: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.

56:2:2.text: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.

56:2:3.text: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.

56:2:4.text: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,

56:2:5.text: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.

56:2:6.text: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.

56:2:7.text: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,

56:2:8.text: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.

56:2:9.text: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,

56:3:1.text: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,

56:3:10.text: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,

56:3:11.text: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.

56:3:12.text: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

56:3:13.text: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.

56:3:14.text: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.

56:3:15.text: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.

56:3:2.text: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.

56:3:3.text: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures — living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

56:3:4.text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,

56:3:5.text: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.

56:3:6.text: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

56:3:7.text: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.

56:3:8.text: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.

56:3:9.text: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.

58:10:1.text: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

58:10:10.text: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

58:10:11.text: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

58:10:12.text: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.

58:10:13.text: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,

58:10:14.text: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.

58:10:15.text: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:

58:10:16.text: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”

58:10:17.text: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”

58:10:18.text: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.

58:10:19.text: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

58:10:2.text: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.

58:10:20.text: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,

58:10:21.text: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

58:10:22.text: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

58:10:23.text: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.

58:10:24.text: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.

58:10:25.text: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

58:10:26.text: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,

58:10:27.text: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.

58:10:28.text: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

58:10:29.text: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?

58:10:3.text: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,

58:10:30.text: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”

58:10:31.text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

58:10:32.text: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.

58:10:33.text: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.

58:10:34.text: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.

58:10:35.text: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.

58:10:36.text: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

58:10:37.text: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.

58:10:38.text: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”

58:10:39.text: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.

58:10:4.text: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

58:10:5.text: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

58:10:6.text: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.

58:10:7.text: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’ ”

58:10:8.text: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).

58:10:9.text: Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.

58:11:1.text: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.

58:11:10.text: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

58:11:11.text: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.

58:11:12.text: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

58:11:13.text: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.

58:11:14.text: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.

58:11:15.text: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

58:11:16.text: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.

58:11:17.text: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,

58:11:18.text: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”

58:11:19.text: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.

58:11:2.text: This is why the ancients were commended.

58:11:20.text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.

58:11:21.text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

58:11:22.text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.

58:11:23.text: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.

58:11:24.text: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

58:11:25.text: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.

58:11:26.text: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.

58:11:27.text: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.

58:11:28.text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.

58:11:29.text: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.

58:11:3.text: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

58:11:30.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

58:11:31.text: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.

58:11:32.text: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,

58:11:33.text: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

58:11:34.text: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.

58:11:35.text: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.

58:11:36.text: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

58:11:37.text: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.

58:11:38.text: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.

58:11:39.text: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.

58:11:4.text: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

58:11:40.text: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.

58:11:5.text: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

58:11:6.text: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.

58:11:7.text: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.

58:11:8.text: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

58:11:9.text: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

58:12:1.text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.

58:12:10.text: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.

58:12:11.text: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.

58:12:12.text: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.

58:12:13.text: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

58:12:14.text: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

58:12:15.text: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.

58:12:16.text: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.

58:12:17.text: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.

58:12:18.text: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;

58:12:19.text: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.

58:12:2.text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

58:12:20.text: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”

58:12:21.text: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”

58:12:22.text: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels

58:12:23.text: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

58:12:24.text: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

58:12:25.text: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?

58:12:26.text: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”

58:12:27.text: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken — that is, created things — so that the unshakable may remain.

58:12:28.text: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.

58:12:29.text: “For our God is a consuming fire.”

58:12:3.text: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

58:12:4.text: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

58:12:5.text: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.

58:12:6.text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”

58:12:7.text: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

58:12:8.text: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.

58:12:9.text: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?

58:13:10.text: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

58:13:11.text: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.

58:13:12.text: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.

58:13:13.text: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.

58:13:14.text: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

58:13:15.text: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.

58:13:16.text: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
