49:6:5.text: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

49:6:6.text: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

49:6:7.text: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

49:6:8.text: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

49:6:9.text: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

50:1:1.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

50:1:10.text: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

50:1:11.text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

50:1:12.text: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

50:1:13.text: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

50:1:14.text: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

50:1:15.text: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

50:1:16.text: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

50:1:17.text: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

50:1:18.text: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

50:1:19.text: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

50:1:2.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

50:1:20.text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

50:1:21.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

50:1:22.text: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

50:1:23.text: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

50:1:24.text: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

50:1:25.text: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

50:1:26.text: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

50:1:27.text: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

50:1:28.text: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

50:1:29.text: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

50:1:3.text: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

50:1:30.text: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

50:1:4.text: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

50:1:5.text: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

50:1:6.text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

50:1:7.text: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

50:1:8.text: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

50:1:9.text: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

50:2:1.text: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

50:2:10.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

50:2:11.text: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

50:2:12.text: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

50:2:13.text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

50:2:14.text: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

50:2:15.text: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

50:2:16.text: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

50:2:17.text: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

50:2:18.text: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

50:2:19.text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

50:2:2.text: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

50:2:20.text: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

50:2:21.text: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

50:2:22.text: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

50:2:23.text: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

50:2:24.text: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

50:2:25.text: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

50:2:26.text: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

50:2:27.text: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

50:2:28.text: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

50:2:29.text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

50:2:3.text: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

50:2:30.text: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

50:2:4.text: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

50:2:5.text: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

50:2:6.text: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

50:2:7.text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

50:2:8.text: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

50:2:9.text: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

50:3:1.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

50:3:10.text: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

50:3:11.text: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

50:3:12.text: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

50:3:13.text: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

50:3:14.text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

50:3:15.text: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

50:3:16.text: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

50:3:17.text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

50:3:18.text: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

50:3:19.text: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

50:3:2.text: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

50:3:20.text: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

50:3:21.text: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

50:3:3.text: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

50:3:4.text: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

50:3:5.text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

50:3:6.text: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

50:3:7.text: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

50:3:8.text: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

50:3:9.text: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

50:4:1.text: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

50:4:10.text: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

50:4:11.text: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

50:4:12.text: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

50:4:13.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

50:4:14.text: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

50:4:15.text: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

50:4:16.text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

50:4:17.text: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

50:4:18.text: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

50:4:19.text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

50:4:2.text: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

50:4:20.text: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

50:4:21.text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

50:4:22.text: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

50:4:23.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

50:4:3.text: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

50:4:4.text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

50:4:5.text: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

50:4:6.text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

50:4:7.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

50:4:8.text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

50:4:9.text: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

51:1:1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

51:1:10.text: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

51:1:11.text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

51:1:12.text: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

51:1:13.text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

51:1:14.text: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

51:1:15.text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

51:1:16.text: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

51:1:17.text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

51:1:18.text: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

51:1:19.text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

51:1:2.text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

51:1:20.text: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

51:1:21.text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

51:1:22.text: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

51:1:23.text: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

51:1:24.text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

51:1:25.text: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

51:1:26.text: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

51:1:27.text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

51:1:28.text: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

51:1:29.text: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

51:1:3.text: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

51:1:4.text: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

51:1:5.text: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

51:1:6.text: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

51:1:7.text: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

51:1:8.text: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

51:1:9.text: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

51:2:1.text: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

51:2:10.text: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

51:2:11.text: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

51:2:12.text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

51:2:13.text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

51:2:14.text: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

51:2:15.text: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

51:2:16.text: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

51:2:17.text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

51:2:18.text: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

51:2:19.text: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

51:2:2.text: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

51:2:20.text: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

51:2:22.text: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

51:2:23.text: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

51:2:3.text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

51:2:4.text: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

51:2:5.text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

51:2:6.text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

51:2:7.text: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

51:2:8.text: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

51:2:9.text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

51:3:1.text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

51:3:10.text: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

51:3:11.text: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

51:3:12.text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

51:3:13.text: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

51:3:14.text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

51:3:15.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

51:3:16.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

51:3:17.text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

51:3:18.text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

51:3:19.text: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

51:3:2.text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

51:3:20.text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

51:3:21.text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

51:3:22.text: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

51:3:23.text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

51:3:24.text: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

51:3:25.text: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

51:3:3.text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

51:3:4.text: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

51:3:5.text: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

51:3:6.text: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

51:3:7.text: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

51:3:8.text: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

51:3:9.text: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

51:4:1.text: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

51:4:10.text: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

51:4:11.text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

51:4:12.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

51:4:13.text: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

51:4:14.text: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

51:4:15.text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

51:4:16.text: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

51:4:17.text: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

51:4:18.text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

51:4:2.text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

51:4:3.text: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

51:4:4.text: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

51:4:5.text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

51:4:6.text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

51:4:7.text: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

51:4:8.text: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

51:4:9.text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

52:1:1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

52:1:10.text: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

52:1:2.text: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

52:1:3.text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

52:1:4.text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

52:1:5.text: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

52:1:6.text: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

52:1:7.text: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

52:1:8.text: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

52:1:9.text: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

52:2:1.text: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

52:2:10.text: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

52:2:11.text: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

52:2:12.text: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

52:2:13.text: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

52:2:14.text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

52:2:15.text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

52:2:16.text: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

52:2:17.text: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

52:2:18.text: because we wanted to come to you — indeed, I, Paul, once and again — but Satan hindered us.

52:2:19.text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

52:2:2.text: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

52:2:20.text: For you are our glory and our joy.

52:2:3.text: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

52:2:4.text: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak — not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

52:2:5.text: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

52:2:6.text: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

52:2:7.text: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

52:2:8.text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

52:2:9.text: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

52:3:1.text: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

52:3:10.text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

52:3:11.text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

52:3:12.text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

52:3:13.text: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

52:3:2.text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

52:3:3.text: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

52:3:4.text: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

52:3:5.text: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

52:3:6.text: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

52:3:7.text: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

52:3:8.text: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

52:3:9.text: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

52:4:1.text: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

52:4:10.text: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

52:4:11.text: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

52:4:12.text: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

52:4:13.text: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

52:4:14.text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

52:4:15.text: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

52:4:16.text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

52:4:17.text: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

52:4:18.text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

52:4:2.text: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

52:4:3.text: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

52:4:4.text: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

52:4:5.text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

52:4:6.text: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

52:4:7.text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

52:4:8.text: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

52:4:9.text: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

52:5:1.text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

52:5:10.text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

52:5:11.text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

52:5:12.text: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

52:5:13.text: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

52:5:14.text: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

52:5:15.text: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

52:5:18.text: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

52:5:2.text: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

52:5:21.text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

52:5:22.text: Abstain from every form of evil.

52:5:23.text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

52:5:24.text: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

52:5:26.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

52:5:27.text: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

52:5:28.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

52:5:3.text: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

52:5:4.text: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

52:5:5.text: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

52:5:6.text: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

52:5:7.text: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

52:5:8.text: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

52:5:9.text: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

53:1:1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

53:1:10.text: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

53:1:11.text: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

53:1:12.text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

53:1:2.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

53:1:3.text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

53:1:4.text: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

53:1:5.text: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

53:1:6.text: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

53:1:7.text: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

53:1:8.text: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

53:1:9.text: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

53:2:1.text: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

53:2:10.text: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

53:2:11.text: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

53:2:12.text: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

53:2:13.text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

53:2:14.text: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

53:2:15.text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

53:2:16.text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

53:2:17.text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

53:2:2.text: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

53:2:3.text: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

53:2:4.text: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

53:2:5.text: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

53:2:6.text: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

53:2:7.text: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

53:2:8.text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

53:2:9.text: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

53:3:1.text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

53:3:10.text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

53:3:11.text: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

53:3:12.text: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

53:3:13.text: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

53:3:14.text: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

53:3:15.text: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

53:3:16.text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

53:3:17.text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

53:3:18.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

53:3:2.text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

53:3:3.text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

53:3:4.text: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

53:3:5.text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

53:3:6.text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

53:3:7.text: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

53:3:8.text: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

53:3:9.text: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

54:1:17.text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

54:1:2.text: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

54:1:20.text: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

54:1:4.text: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

54:1:9.text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

54:2:10.text: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

54:2:11.text: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

54:2:12.text: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

54:2:13.text: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

54:2:14.text: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

54:2:15.text: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

54:2:5.text: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

54:2:7.text: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle — I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying — a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

54:2:8.text: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

54:2:9.text: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

54:3:10.text: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

54:3:11.text: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

54:3:12.text: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

54:3:13.text: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

54:3:14.text: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

54:3:15.text: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

54:3:16.text: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

54:3:2.text: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

54:3:3.text: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

54:3:4.text: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

54:3:5.text: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

54:3:6.text: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

54:3:7.text: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

54:3:8.text: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

54:3:9.text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

54:4:12.text: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

54:4:13.text: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

54:4:14.text: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

54:4:15.text: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

54:4:16.text: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

54:4:6.text: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

54:4:7.text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

54:4:8.text: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

54:4:9.text: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

54:5:15.text: For already some have turned away after Satan.

54:5:17.text: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

54:5:18.text: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

54:5:19.text: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

54:5:21.text: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

54:5:22.text: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

54:5:23.text: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

54:5:24.text: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

54:5:25.text: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

54:5:3.text: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

54:5:5.text: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

54:5:6.text: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

54:5:7.text: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

54:5:8.text: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

54:5:9.text: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

54:6:1.text: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

54:6:10.text: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

54:6:11.text: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

54:6:12.text: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

54:6:13.text: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

54:6:14.text: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

54:6:15.text: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

54:6:16.text: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

54:6:18.text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

54:6:19.text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

54:6:2.text: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

54:6:5.text: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

54:6:6.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

54:6:7.text: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

54:6:8.text: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

54:6:9.text: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

55:1:10.text: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

55:1:11.text: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

55:1:12.text: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

55:1:13.text: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

55:1:14.text: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

55:1:15.text: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

55:1:16.text: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

55:1:17.text: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

55:1:18.text: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

55:1:2.text: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

55:1:3.text: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

55:1:4.text: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

55:1:5.text: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

55:1:6.text: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

55:1:7.text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

55:1:8.text: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

55:1:9.text: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

55:2:1.text: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

55:2:10.text: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

55:2:11.text: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

55:2:12.text: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

55:2:13.text: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

55:2:14.text: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

55:2:15.text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

55:2:16.text: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

55:2:17.text: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

55:2:18.text: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

55:2:19.text: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

55:2:2.text: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

55:2:20.text: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

55:2:21.text: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

55:2:22.text: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

55:2:23.text: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

55:2:24.text: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

55:2:25.text: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

55:2:26.text: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

55:2:3.text: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

55:2:4.text: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

55:2:5.text: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

55:2:6.text: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

55:2:7.text: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

55:2:8.text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

55:2:9.text: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

55:3:1.text: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

55:3:10.text: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

55:3:11.text: persecutions, and sufferings — those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

55:3:12.text: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

55:3:13.text: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

55:3:14.text: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

55:3:15.text: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

55:3:16.text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

55:3:17.text: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

55:3:2.text: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

55:3:3.text: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

55:3:4.text: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

55:3:5.text: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

55:3:6.text: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

55:3:7.text: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

55:3:8.text: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

55:3:9.text: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

55:4:1.text: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

55:4:10.text: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

55:4:11.text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

55:4:12.text: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

55:4:13.text: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come — and the books, especially the parchments.

55:4:14.text: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

55:4:15.text: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

55:4:16.text: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

55:4:17.text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

55:4:18.text: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

55:4:19.text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

55:4:2.text: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

55:4:20.text: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

55:4:21.text: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

55:4:22.text: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

55:4:3.text: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

55:4:4.text: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

55:4:5.text: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

55:4:6.text: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

55:4:7.text: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

55:4:8.text: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

55:4:9.text: Be diligent to come to me soon,

56:1:1.text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

56:1:10.text: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

56:1:11.text: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

56:1:12.text: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

56:1:13.text: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

56:1:14.text: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

56:1:15.text: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

56:1:16.text: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

56:1:2.text: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

56:1:3.text: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

56:1:4.text: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

56:1:5.text: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you —

56:1:6.text: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

56:1:7.text: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

56:1:8.text: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

56:1:9.text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

56:2:1.text: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

56:2:10.text: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

56:2:11.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

56:2:12.text: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

56:2:13.text: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

56:2:14.text: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

56:2:15.text: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

56:2:2.text: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

56:2:3.text: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

56:2:4.text: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

56:2:5.text: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

56:2:6.text: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

56:2:7.text: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

56:2:8.text: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

56:2:9.text: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

56:3:1.text: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

56:3:10.text: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

56:3:11.text: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

56:3:12.text: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

56:3:13.text: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

56:3:14.text: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

56:3:15.text: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

56:3:2.text: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

56:3:3.text: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

56:3:4.text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

56:3:5.text: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

56:3:6.text: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

56:3:7.text: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

56:3:8.text: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

56:3:9.text: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

58:10:1.text: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

58:10:10.text: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

58:10:11.text: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

58:10:12.text: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

58:10:13.text: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

58:10:14.text: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

58:10:15.text: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

58:10:16.text: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

58:10:17.text: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

58:10:18.text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

58:10:19.text: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

58:10:2.text: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

58:10:20.text: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

58:10:21.text: and having a great priest over God’s house,

58:10:22.text: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

58:10:23.text: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

58:10:24.text: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

58:10:25.text: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

58:10:26.text: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

58:10:27.text: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

58:10:28.text: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

58:10:29.text: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

58:10:3.text: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

58:10:30.text: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

58:10:31.text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

58:10:32.text: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

58:10:33.text: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

58:10:34.text: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

58:10:35.text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

58:10:36.text: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

58:10:37.text: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

58:10:38.text: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

58:10:39.text: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

58:10:4.text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

58:11:1.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

58:11:10.text: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

58:11:11.text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

58:11:12.text: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

58:11:13.text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

58:11:14.text: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

58:11:15.text: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

58:11:16.text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

58:11:17.text: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

58:11:18.text: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

58:11:19.text: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

58:11:2.text: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

58:11:20.text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

58:11:21.text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

58:11:22.text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

58:11:23.text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

58:11:24.text: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

58:11:25.text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

58:11:26.text: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

58:11:27.text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

58:11:28.text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

58:11:29.text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

58:11:3.text: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

58:11:30.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

58:11:31.text: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

58:11:32.text: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets —

58:11:33.text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

58:11:34.text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

58:11:35.text: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

58:11:36.text: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

58:11:37.text: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated —

58:11:38.text: of whom the world was not worthy — wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

58:11:39.text: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

58:11:4.text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

58:11:40.text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

58:11:5.text: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

58:11:6.text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

58:11:7.text: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

58:11:8.text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

58:11:9.text: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

58:12:25.text: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

58:12:26.text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

58:12:27.text: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

58:12:28.text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

58:12:29.text: for our God is a consuming fire.

58:12:3.text: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

58:12:4.text: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

58:12:5.text: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

58:12:6.text: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

58:12:7.text: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

58:12:8.text: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

58:12:9.text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

58:13:10.text: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

58:13:11.text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

58:13:12.text: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

58:13:13.text: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

58:13:14.text: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

58:13:15.text: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

58:13:16.text: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
